before_times: the kind of visit (new consult, follow-up, overnight study, home test kit, mask fitting, home set-up)
whether it's a video follow-up (counts as at the center)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a child's overnight study: the child's age, and a parent who stays overnight
for a home visit: the town and whether the patient can come to the door
after_time: a note for the technologist: a past faint, or a bed partner who needs a say
for a home visit: the address, parking and any gate code
secure_page_only: the sleep history (on the secure page only)
date of birth (every study is matched to the patient by two details)
medicines that matter, only where the study asks (sedating ones)
for an overnight study: who picks up a child in the morning
who may get the results: the patient; a parent or guardian for a child
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (who stays overnight for a child's study); a bed partner may not book for the patient

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, or a stroke sign (face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking)

go_on.words: a near-crash from falling asleep at the wheel, or a fall during the night
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the sleep doctor is told that day, and the nurse line calls within the hour

go_on.words: a question about a result or a medicine
go_on.what: never answered by Rosie: the center's nurse line; the sleep doctor is told that day

go_on.words: feels unsafe at home or with a partner
go_on.what: the family-violence line's words come first, then the booking goes on privately; the team is told that day, with no detail in any text

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking

steps.name: A sleep history for a new patient
steps.when: on the secure page before the first consult
steps.result: done: booked; not done: the desk asks once, then the consult waits

steps.name: A parent's OK for a child's overnight study
steps.when: on the secure page before the study, with the overnight stay named
steps.result: OK on file: booked; no OK: no study

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: by the desk before the visit
steps.result: covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit

steps.name: The home test kit's pick-up and return
steps.when: at the desk when the kit is picked up; the box returned by mail
steps.result: returned: the test is read; not returned: the sleep doctor is told, and a new kit is offered with no charge

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: a night's bag, pajamas, the usual medicines, photo ID and the plan card; for a study: no caffeine or alcohol for the day, and the sleep center's own instructions; for a home visit, clear the bedside

staff.skills: in-lab sleep studies, home sleep tests, CPAP mask fitting, pediatric sleep studies, Spanish
staff.licenses_or_certificates: a sleep doctor's state license; a technologist's certificate where the state requires one; the center keeps its own record (optional, never looked up by Rosie)
staff.supervision: the sleep doctor reads every study; a new technologist works under a senior one until signed off
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs new patients, refunds and any study price
staff.stand_in: a patient may ask for a named doctor; the next open one with the skill takes it otherwise; an overnight study stays with its night team

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (who stays overnight for a child's study); a bed partner may not book for the patient
children_and_age.minors_texts: a child's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the desk: the code, then photo ID and the plan card checked against the secure page; an overnight study checks in in the evening with a technologist; a home visit: the code at the door, then photo ID
visit.done: the code, then DONE from the technologist; the sleep doctor reads the result; results go to the patient's secure page; Rosie keeps only booking records
visit.changes_at_visit: the sleep doctor adds a follow-up or a mask fitting: priced first, with the self-pay price shown; nothing else is sold at a visit

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: a state license for each sleep doctor and nurse practitioner; a sleep technologist's certificate where the state requires one; the sleep center's registration where the state's rules require it; a technologist who sets up a test or a mask at home only where the state allows it
license.who: both: the center, and each clinician or technologist who sees patients
license.ask: optional, for the owner's own page: each clinician's license number and the center's registration; nothing is needed to book
license.insurance: the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it
license.background: the center's own background checks for staff who go into a patient's home, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them

never_in_a_text: the sleep history, test names, results, medicines, the child's details, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the center's name, the day, the time and the place
